subject: TheraPex - SIG/CAIQ: customer-specific log TTL and evidence handoff
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@therapex.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@therapex.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: SIG/CAIQ follow-up - log retention carveout question

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Our compliance team is updating the SIG spread and flagged a couple of items where TheraPex needs confirmation of Redwood's handling of tenant-scoped logs and short-lived tracing data. Two asks: 1) For customer-configurable session/debug traces (ephemeral by default), can you provide the exact retention controls and whether TherpaPex can request a per-tenant override to extend retention to 90 days for forensics? 2) We need an evidence packet (diagram + artifact list) that shows how deletions are executed and how you attest deletion to customers — ideally something we can include with our SOC 2 workpapers.

Attached is our current SIG sheet (we added notes in column F). Could you let me know what artifacts you can supply in the next 5 business days? We may need a quick follow-up call.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Sr. IT Compliance Manager
TheraPex Therapeutics

Attachments: TheraPex_SIG_v2.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@therapex.com>
Cc: priy a.natarajan@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up - log retention carveout question

Elena —

Appreciate the signal and the sheet. Short answers up front: yes, we support tenant-specific retention overrides for debug/session traces; the request path is documented and requires an authorized change (signed MA/PO or equivalent). We do not automatically extend retention without a customer request and documented justification.

Details we will include in the packet:
- retention control flow (how to request, approval gates, TTL enforcement)
- a deletion attestation template + example output from our deletion job for a test tenant
- list of logs/artifacts considered ephemeral vs. persistent (and TTL defaults)
- cryptographically verifiable evidence we can provide (snapshot manifest, deletion job run IDs)

Two quick clarifying questions so we tailor the deliverables:
1) When you say "extend to 90 days" — is that for all ephemeral traces (session + debug + kv-cache traces) or just a subset (forensics-only snapshots)?
2) Do you need retention policy language we can include in a contract addendum (yes/no)? If yes, we can draft a short clause.

I'll coordinate with Priya and Jonas on the evidence generation. If you confirm Q1/Q2 by end of day PT, we can drop a first evidence pack by Monday (14 Dec).

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
Contact: +1 415-555-0192
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@therapex.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@therapex.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up - log retention carveout question

Vivek — thanks. Clarifications: 1) We need the full 90 days for all ephemeral traces for a limited set of production tenants while they investigate an incident (so session + debug + transient inference traces). 2) Yes please, draftable addendum language would be helpful — our legal team prefers a short clause we can attach to the MSA.

For the evidence pack, priority items: deletion attestation example (with run IDs), list of artifacts and canonical names, and a sample manifest we can present to auditors. Also: screenshots of the console page where an admin requests a tenant retention override (to show the approval workflow).

I've attached a redacted screenshot of our SSO/JIT token page for mapping (therapex_sso_screenshot.png) and left comments in the SIG file (column F). Let me know if we should hop on 30m.

Thanks,
Elena

Following up with the artifacts we promised.
